consequence.statement: New opt-in `{{- ... }}` notation; default nested substitution is stated to remain, and nothing fails if the operator does nothing.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a `{{- ... }}` notation for shallow (one-time) variable substitution, so nested `{{ }}` content such as HCL is not resolved.

checks.detail: the subject and change are not both confirmed by an artifact validator
